title: Reaching for Paradise
text: Amazing tour, one of the best experiences of my life.  My guide Christina was incredible possessing an impressive depth and breadth of knowledge in history, art, and cultural.  She pointed out features in the larger context as well as the smallest of building construction details, enhancing the visually beautiful with their historical symbolism, and their deeper philosophical or religious meaning. title: Not all tours are the same
text: Vicente provided an outstanding tour of the Alhambra. He brought a great deal of experience and knowledge. But most importantly, he was genuinely enthusiastic and interested in sharing the history, drama and culture of this extraordinary place. Highly recommend.
